name: Judas Iscariot
overview: Judas Iscariot is depicted in Scripture as the betrayer of Jesus Christ, one of the twelve disciples who was entered by Satan to fulfill the role of traitor (Luke 6:16; 22:3). His betrayal fulfills the painful reality of a trusted friend turning against the Messiah, as foretold in Psalms 41:9. After his act of betrayal, Judas experienced remorse, returning the thirty pieces of silver before taking his own life (Matthew 27:3, 5). His story serves as a solemn warning about the consequences of sin and the tragic results of rejecting Christ's offer of grace.
